reference.note: N2 entries matched to the candidate's own triggers (same farm), same exit rule

main_measure.statistic: the point with the lower mean return per filled trade after base costs (settle_sql ret, base scenario); 95% day-bootstrap CI (report._boot, seed 7)

run.1_store: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=7G -p CPUQuota=200% -- flock -n ../../data-old-faithful-one/lab/locks/heavy.lock env LAB_SPILL_DIR=/dev/shm/lab-store-build LAB_SPILL_MAX=2GB LAB_DUCKDB_MEM=3GB LAB_POOL_PARTS=16 nice -n 10 $LAB_PY -m backtest.store holdout --final
run.1_store_note: builds store/holdout.duckdb over [451872000, 454464000): epoch 1046 (dev) as warm-up for the 24 h burn-in, then the hold-out; holdout.lock refuses a second build
run.2_tournament: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=7G -p CPUQuota=200% -- flock -n ../../data-old-faithful-one/lab/locks/heavy.lock env LAB_STORE=../../data-old-faithful-one/lab/store/holdout.duckdb LAB_SPILL_DIR=/dev/shm/holdout-1047-1051 LAB_SPILL_MAX=2GB LAB_SQL_BUCKETS=64 nice -n 10 scripts/backtest-run.sh holdout-1047-1051 --families F7,N2 --segments pool_reversed --sizes 0.5 --delays 1,2,3 --q 0.5,0.9 --decide 452304000:454464000 --workers 2 --batch holdout_final
run.2_tournament_note: all nine F7 pool_reversed variants are simulated (the engine has no variant filter); only K1-K3 and N2_F7 are evaluated, the other variants' numbers are not read
run.3_evaluation_note: writes holdout_eval.md and holdout_eval.json in the run directory; the report lab/reports/<date>-holdout.md is holdout_eval.md plus the run's report.md header
